_comment: Dev/build-toolchain advisories accepted ONLY because no fixed version exists. Read by scripts/audit-gate.mjs. An advisory listed here is tolerated; ANY high/critical advisory NOT listed here fails the build, and so does an entry here that has stopped appearing (that means a fix shipped and the entry must be deleted). This file is the reason the dev audit is not `|| true`.
_scope: high and critical only — moderate and below do not block the dev half, so they are deliberately not listed here. Production dependencies get a separate blocking `npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=moderate` with NO allowlist and no exceptions. Every field of an entry is compared: ghsa + package + severity + nodes + isDirect + paths. isDirect true is rejected outright — a dependency we chose to add must have its advisory fixed or the dependency dropped.

allowed.title: undici vulnerable to cross-user information disclosure and parse-time crash via degenerate private cache directives
allowed.why: Dev/build toolchain only — this undici is miniflare's local Workers emulator and is never bundled into the deployed Worker. The exemption is bound to the COMPLETE SET OF LOCKFILE PATHS (root > wrangler > miniflare > undici, by node path and resolved version, and no other) and to isDirect false, because that ancestry IS the justification: we carry it only because wrangler needs miniflare. A direct undici dependency, or undici reached any other way, is a different decision and must fail this gate. No wrangler release exists without a vulnerable miniflare; npm's remediation downgrades wrangler 4.118 -> 4.35.0, surrendering ~80 releases of fixes to silence a dev-only finding. Accepted as build-host exposure, NOT shippable surface. The other four undici advisories in this chain are moderate and therefore do not block; they are intentionally absent rather than allowlisted.
